data.name: BattleVox
data.detailed_description:
🎯 BattleVox — Large-Scale Battle Royale FPS

BattleVox is a battle royale multiplayer focused shooter delivering intense combat, where players fight until the last man standing. Each game supports up to 100 player encounters in competitive matches designed around positioning, movement, and survival.

🌍 Maps, Scale & Combat

Engage in battles across large, big, and massive maps, featuring open world layouts built for scale. Every map supports varied modes, dynamic systems, and evolving combat scenarios that keep each experience fresh from drop to endgame.

🕹️ Online or Offline Play

Play multiplayer online in pvp encounters against real opponents, or enjoy a singleplayer solo experience without internet fully offline against AI-controlled enemies with full progression enabled, progression is shared between online and offline modes. Fight bots, bot units, adaptive ai, intelligent enemies, or the computer, with or without matchmaking, in fully playable sessions designed to work online or offline.

🧍 Character Customization & Progression

Customize your soldier with deep character progression built for long-term play. Unlock new visual styles, gear options, and unique looks as you survive more battles and improve performance. Progression is persistent and directly tied to your playstyle, whether you focus on aggressive combat, smart positioning, or survival.

Every match contributes to meaningful, rewarding progression.

🔫 Progression, Loot & Practice

BattleVox features a flexible loot system built for long-term games. Improve through practice, training, and warmup options, choose competitive or casual playstyles, and progress through ranked or non ranked paths as an alternative approach to standard shooters.

🎨 Visual Style & Development

The game uses a stylized, low poly, cubic, minimalist look that stays readable during fast paced action while remaining relaxed outside combat. Built as an indie project in early access, development focuses on unique and experimental updates shaped by feedback.

🔫 Weapon Skins, Loadouts & Long-Term Progression

All weapons support customizable skins and visual upgrades earned through gameplay. Experiment with different loadouts, refine your shooting style, and personalize your arsenal. The loot system feeds directly into shared progression, so every battle royale run matters.

From low poly, cubic, and minimalist designs to bold stylized finishes, weapons stay readable while feeling unique.

🧩 Freedom & Stability

Fight across a variety of modes, from large team-based battles to smaller fast paced firefights, including objective based experiences alongside classic battle royale rulesets. Join public matches through matchmaking or host custom games to play on your own terms.

Designed to avoid cheaters, unstable connection issues, or forced metas, BattleVox gives you control. There is no dependency on constant matchmaking — just a shooting, first person shooter focused on choice, scale, and replayable survival.

data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Danish, Spanish - Latin America, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Norwegian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Czech, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64) - Windows 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.2 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU, Intel HD Graphics 5100 / AMD Radeon 77XX / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable GPU, Intel Iris Pro 5200 or AMD/Nvidia equivalent for Mac
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux Ubuntu 12.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 200 Series or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
